publication.title: Graph Queries from Natural Language using Constrained Language Models and Visual Editing

adjudication.basis: The system combines generated RDF prototype queries with transparent, editable visual refinement and live instance results; it therefore exceeds isolated question answering. Primary manuscript documents the pipeline and an 11-participant preliminary study.

codes.notes: Generated query graphs corrected/edited visually; property constraints available in visual editor, not initial generation. Historical comparator gets no E05. Query/model hardware not a latency benchmark.

implementation_engines.name: OnSET/constrained language models/sentence embeddings
implementation_engines.role: generation, semantic alignment and visual editing

tasks: 128 queries per node-size setting; five model variants/four ontologies
Four DBpedia tasks; historical RDF Explorer comparison only

descriptions.interaction: NL input produces inspectable prototype query graph; users add/remove nodes and relations and impose property constraints through a visual editor, with results tied to the prototype.
descriptions.guidance: Semantic class/relation retrieval, grammar-constrained generation, flipping invalid edge direction/removing invalid edges, pipeline visualisation and semantic expansion; generated filters not yet supported.
descriptions.visualisation: Prototype graph, ontology circle-packing view, matching instance graphs and transparent processing flow.
descriptions.backend: RDF ontology/BGP-based SPARQL generation; OnSET editor; sentence embeddings and two-stage grammar-constrained language-model extraction.

resources.notes: README names OnSET and describes topic/NL query and ontology exploration views. Live demo is labelled in progress; no deployment is established from the repository landing.
